name: انتزاعی و فلسفی
description: واژگان مربوط به مفاهیم انتزاعی، فلسفه و تفکر انتقادی

words.example: Ontology examines the nature of being.
Epistemology questions the limits of knowledge.
Idealism emphasizes the primacy of ideas.
Determinism claims all events are caused.
Compatibilism reconciles free will and determinism.
The thesis presents the main argument.
A paradigm shift transformed the field.
Essence defines what a thing truly is.
Contingency means it could be otherwise.
The syllogism is a logical argument.
Abstract concepts are hard to grasp.
Conceptualism mediates between realism and nominalism.
Historical materialism explains history through economics.
A priori knowledge is independent of experience.
A posteriori knowledge comes from experience.
Deduction moves from general to specific.
Induction moves from specific to general.
The theory has great explanatory power.
A corollary follows from the theorem.
Dialectic is a method of inquiry.
Free will is debated in philosophy.
Alienation separates workers from their labor.
The will to power drives human action.
When you gaze into the abyss, it gazes back.
Via negativa describes God by what He is not.
The supplement is both addition and replacement.
Hyperreality blurs the line between real and simulation.
The Body without Organs resists organization.
The plane of immanence organizes thought.
The body politic is governed by laws.
The signifier points to the signified.
